# Verilog versions under fpga/verilog (generated by tools/verilog_versions_v1.py)

For each versioned core family: the versions present, and for every OLDER one what still names it. `none` means nothing live does: it can be moved to `fpga/archive/`. Testbenches (`tb_*`) do not count. `v4` / `v4c` and `v1` / `v1c` pairs are variants (the `c` one drops the addon chain for the carrier), not replacements, so they are not listed as older. The same goes for `e` (the VIXeN carrier cores) and `s` / `sa` (sub / flex). The number is the level; a letter marks a variant branch that the assembler never picks automatically (docs/stripped-cell/CORES_AND_WRAPPERS_REFERENCE.md, 'How the version names work', ledger #1177).
